## Description


`CacheTransferLayer::validateSupport()` raises a generic error when a
context executor's cacheState is incompatible with a generation
executor's cacheState:
> Disagg server does not currently support these cacheState, please
> check the cacheState of the context and gen executors

`inquireSupport()` does log which field mismatched, but as a separate
`TLLM_LOG_WARNING` that carries no values for most fields (e.g. "only
support same tokens per block and size per head"). So the exception
alone is not actionable, and debugging a disagg setup mismatch still
means re-deriving both configs by hand.

`CacheState` already has a `toString()` debug dump with all the
relevant fields. This PR appends both sides' dump to the exception
message so the mismatch is visible directly in the error.


## Change
- `validateSupport()` now includes `mCacheState.toString()` and
  `peerCacheState.toString()` in both the KV and RNN
  `TLLM_CHECK_WITH_INFO` messages.
- Sides are labelled `self` / `peer`, not context / generation:
  `validateSupport()` runs on **both** ends of the handshake --
  `recvRequestInfo()` on the context side, `sendRequestInfo()` on the
  generation side -- so a fixed role label would be wrong on one of them.
- Minor cleanup: reuse a single `peerCacheState` reference instead of
  repeated `peerState.getCacheState().value()` calls.


## Test Coverage


- No behavior change for supported cacheStates: `inquireSupport()`
  logic is untouched, and the `toString()` calls are only evaluated on
  the failure branch of `TLLM_CHECK_WITH_INFO`.
- `fmtstr` is printf-style and declared
  `__attribute__((format(printf, 1, 2)))`, so the `%s` / `.c_str()`
  pairing is checked at compile time. `TLLM_CHECK_WITH_INFO` evaluates
  it only in the failure arm of its ternary, so `toString()` does not
  run on the success path.
